attributes.additional_details:
The Act 2026 introduces a generational tobacco ban affecting those born after 31 December 2008. I believe this creates unequal treatment between adults based on their birth dates. As a young person directly affected, I call for repeal and fairer alternatives to protect public health, support the NHS and uphold equal rights.
I also propose exploring tobacco levies to help fund NHS treatment for smoking-related illnesses, without penalising patients. 
Protect personal freedom and equal rights.
attributes.background: Repeal the generational tobacco ban introduced by the Tobacco and Vapes Act 2026 and restore equal legal access to tobacco products for all adults aged 18 and over, regardless of their date of birth.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: Keep the legal age to buy tobacco at 18 https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768064
